verdict.rationale: Requesty is an API-first gateway that can be driven without a UI. It is OpenAI-SDK compatible, offers service accounts for non-human entities with their own keys and spend caps, and publishes an OpenAPI spec covering the management API, so automated pipelines can use it programmatically. However, no CI-specific guidance or documented headless/CI workflow exists in the evidence. missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration guides or examples, a CLI or explicit headless-automation workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Service accounts allow you create non-human entities
Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap.
covering both the OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible inference router and the management API
